definitions.explanation: Most commonly refers to thick Japanese-style omelette (厚焼き卵), but can also describe thick-grilled versions of other foods.

examples.japanese: {厚焼|あつや}き⟦{卵|たまご}→卵：02222_tamago⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{好|す}き→好き：02355_suki⟧です。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧お⟦{寿司屋|すしや}→寿司屋：10166_sushiya⟧さん⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{厚焼|あつや}き⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{絶品|ぜっぴん}→絶品：13811_zeppin⟧だ。
examples.english: The thick omelette at this sushi restaurant is superb.

examples.japanese: {厚焼|あつや}き{玉子|たまご}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{上手|じょうず}→上手：00707_jouzu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{作|つく}る→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{練習|れんしゅう}→練習：05323_renshuu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧だ。
examples.english: You need practice to make a good thick omelette.

notes:
Combines ⟦{厚|あつ}い→厚い：00690_atsui⟧ (thick) and ⟦{焼|や}き→焼く：01123_yaku⟧ (grilled/baked). Most commonly encountered as {厚焼|あつや}き⟦{卵|たまご}→卵：02222_tamago⟧/{厚焼|あつや}き{玉子|たまご}, the thick Japanese-style rolled omelette often served at sushi restaurants. The thick version is distinct from the thinner, sweeter ⟦{出汁巻|だしま}き{卵|たまご}→出汁巻き卵：08601_dashimakitamago⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {厚焼|あつや}き⟦{卵|たまご}→卵：02222_tamago⟧: thick omelette
- {厚焼|あつや}き{玉子|たまご}: thick egg omelette (alternative kanji)
- {厚焼|あつや}きせんべい: thick rice crackers

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{卵焼|たまごや}き→卵焼き：10367_tamagoyaki⟧: Japanese omelette — general term for rolled egg
- ⟦{出汁巻|だしま}き{卵|たまご}→出汁巻き卵：08601_dashimakitamago⟧: dashi-flavored rolled omelette — thinner, Kansai style
- {薄焼|うすや}き: thin-grilled — the opposite, as in thin crêpe-like preparations
